_comment: Rollout knob for the MD-first write-time gate (check-md-first.mjs, md-first-gate.sh). Fires on PreToolUse Edit|Write|NotebookEdit for clients/*/tests/**/*.spec.ts writes. off = gate disabled; announce = allows the write but emits a warning + appends fire telemetry (warn-only, ramp default); deny = blocks the write + appends fire telemetry. Every deny/announce verdict appends one line to .claude/state/gate-fires.log (gate, ISO timestamp, verdict, target-path). Read by check-md-first.mjs readGateMode(); MD_FIRST_MODE env overrides in tests. Ramp to deny per Phase 3.3 discipline: never straight to deny for S1 — land at announce, ramp after zero false positives for N clean sessions, record flip in ramp_flipped.
_provenance: PLAN_REACTIVE_VS_PREVENTIVE_GUARDRAIL_AUDIT Phase 2 Step 2. Sev=S1 per §3.1 rubric (silent quality drift surviving to commit/ship — MD↔spec parity drift). Graduating incident: 2026-07-08 MD↔XLSX↔spec parity slip (commit 664ae0cc; TC IDs written to spec with no MD source row via --no-verify). Landed announce per Phase 3.3 ramp discipline (S1: announce on first, deny on second confirmed recurrence). One shared guardrail-config.json, not one file per gate (Phase 3.3 mandate).
ramp_note: Flip md_first_mode to 'deny' after 5 clean sessions with zero false positives and zero announce fires for genuinely-absent IDs. Record flip date in ramp_flipped and set ramp_complete to true.
_mistake_ledger_comment: Rollout knob for the mistake-ledger Stop-hook gate (check-mistake-ledger.mjs, mistake-ledger-gate.sh). Fires on Stop events for mutating sessions that end with no mistake attestation. off = gate disabled; announce = warns + persists state entry (mode=announce, verdict floor YELLOW) + telemetry warn; deny = escalation mode: same as announce (non-veto per Stop-hook nature — LR-060) but persists mode=deny in state entry (floors verdict to RED) and emits warn-deny in telemetry; unknown value fails SAFE to announce. Sev=S1 per §3.1 rubric (silent omission of session mistake record surviving to session end). Graduating incident: 2026-07-10 owner directive — /reflect + /final-q prose mandate is Tier-3 (weakest layer) without a structural backstop. Landed announce per Phase 3.3 ramp discipline (S1: announce on first, deny on second confirmed recurrence). Rule body: LR-069 §3.2 in .claude/rules/guardrail-policy.md.
mistake_ledger_ramp_note: promote to deny after 10 consecutive mutating sessions end attested with zero false-positive warnings (stale mid-session warning files cleared on attestation do not count as fires). deny is non-veto per LR-060 (Stop hooks cannot block); it floors the verdict to RED and emits warn-deny in telemetry vs YELLOW/warn for announce.
_stall_note: PBUG-12 (2026-07-16): the former 'stall_guard_mode' key here was DEAD — no .mjs/.sh under .claude/scripts/pipeline reads it (grep-verified). The live stall knob is STALL_MODE in ~/.claude/delegation/config.json, read by the dispatch wrapper (copilot-worker.sh). Change stall behavior THERE, not here. The stall_guard_ramp_* keys below are retained as human-read ramp documentation only.
_stall_guard_comment: Rollout knob for the Phase 1 stall guard (the dispatch wrapper, PLAN_STATIC_TO_DYNAMIC). warn = fire STALL-WARN to stall.log + META stall_warns, do NOT kill; kill = arm the guard to terminate stalled dispatches; off = disable. Ramp discipline per LR-069 §3.3: land warn, promote to kill only after ramp criterion is met. Graduating incident: tavily-mcp-build-01 killed at static 600s wall ceiling while producing output (2026-07-10, ledger-verified double-spend).
stall_guard_ramp_note: warn-only until ≥20 dispatches show zero false STALL-WARNs on later-successful runs; then arm kill
_uplink_mode_KNOWN_GAP: FLAGGED-NOT-FIXED 2026-07-13: the dispatch wrapper does NOT read this key. Its uplink-fire helper hardcodes the literal 'announce' (wrapper line ~151) and no 'enforce' code path exists. Flipping uplink_mode to 'enforce' is a SILENT NO-OP today — the enforce wiring (real consult + advisory injection) must be built in the wrapper before this knob does anything. Do not trust uplink_ramp_target below until that lands. Surfaced by a cross-family gap-hunt debate; ranking + evidence in the delegation decision-debates.jsonl (2026-07-13 entry). Left as a flag by owner direction; if still unused later it gets removed anyway.
_uplink_comment: Rollout knob for the uplink consult machinery (UPLINK_DOCTRINE §2 calibration ≡ LR-069 ramp; wires in the dispatch wrapper UW-1..4 + .claude/hooks/lib/uplink/*.mjs; HARD policy in ~/.claude/delegation/uplink-policy.json). announce = trip-wires log CONSULT-WOULD-FIRE to uplink.log + gate-fires.log, NOTHING is killed/consulted/injected; enforce = wires actually fire consults + inject binding advisories; off = disabled. Sev S1 per LR-069 §3.1 (assumption-leak survives to ship). Graduating incident: Rutvik owner directive 2026-07-12 — agents assume, managers miss it, assumption failures leak to the deliverable uncaught. Rule body: LR-070 in .claude/rules/guardrail-policy.md. Every fire appends one CSV line to .claude/state/gate-fires.log.
uplink_ramp_note: Phase 7 (PLAN_UPLINK_PROTOCOL) is a separate future session by design. Flip uplink_mode to 'enforce' ONLY after: >=20 announce-mode dispatches logged; trip-rate lands in the 10-20%-of-decision-points band (doctrine §2); zero false CONSULT-WOULD-FIRE on runs that ended green without help; budgets never breached by logging alone. Trip-rate >20% => fix tickets/harness FIRST, do not arm. Record ramp_flipped date + set uplink_ramp_complete true on flip.
skill_route_deferred_reason: earning-rent: need >=30 reviewed dispatches to prove rent; false-fire on rule-only/manual tickets unresolved
skill_route_ramp_prerequisite: reviewer SKILL-SKIP rate >20% across 30 dispatches with the scan recipe active
_skill_route_comment: Deferral knob for the wrapper-side skill-route validation wire (UW-5/UW-6, PLAN_WORKER_SKILL_ROUTING Deliverable 2.4). DEFERRED, not ramping: no wrapper grep fires today. The scan recipe (worker-ext.md dispatch step 1) + the reviewer evidence-signature check are the two live layers. Wire a post-dispatch detective (UW-6, copilot-worker.sh:501+) only after the earning-rent prerequisite is met. Sev S2 per LR-069.
_reviewer_skill_compliance_comment: Rollout knob for the reviewer's Skill Methodology Compliance check (council-reviewer.agent.md). announce = SKILL-COMPLIANCE/SKILL-SKIP is a DIGEST finding only, no auto-bounce; the dispatcher evaluates materiality. Promote to auto-bounce after >=10 reviewed dispatches with skill DOCTRINE where SKILL-SKIP false-positive rate <5%. Sev S2 per LR-069 §3.1. Graduating incident: TICKET-worker-skills-design-v2-0712 (workers cited SKILL.md in DOCTRINE_READ but methodology compliance was unchecked by the reviewer). Rule: PLAN_WORKER_SKILL_ROUTING Deliverable 3.1.
reviewer_skill_compliance_ramp_note: promote to auto-bounce after >=10 reviewed dispatches with skill DOCTRINE where SKILL-SKIP false-positive rate <5%; record ramp_flipped date + set ramp_complete true on flip
